uploadEvidence: Kevin authorized the six compatibility replacements to be uploaded to the existing bucket root. The one six-file upload batch succeeded. All ten final public URLs were downloaded and verified against exact reviewed SHA-256 and byte counts, then fully decoded.
frameReview: Production review used sampled source frames and final contact sheets. The corrected Water/Amalek support shot was independently compared with approved Aaron and Moses references at 6.0, 8.0 and 9.5 seconds. Samples do not certify every motion frame.

records.title: Moses and Aaron Before Pharaoh
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H.264 Main 3.1, one-second keyframes, no B frames, copied AAC, faststart MP4
records.posterAlt: Moses and Aaron face a seated Pharaoh in an imagined Egyptian columned hall.
records.description: Moses and Aaron appeal to Pharaoh in a columned hall. Pharaoh turns aside. Later, Moses watches workers press mud into brick molds.
records.reviewLimits: Selective wordless montage: refusal and labor burden. Omits the foremen's appeal, Moses' question to God, and renewed covenant promises. Sampled Moses identity and adult anatomy checked against approved reference; no listening review.

records.title: The Plagues of Egypt
records.posterAlt: A farmer shields his face beneath a locust swarm beside canal farmland.
records.description: A farmer shields his face as locusts sweep across fields beside an Egyptian canal. Dense darkness settles over a deserted mudbrick lane.
records.reviewLimits: Selective locust and darkness montage; other plagues and Pharaoh's responses are omitted. Nile job EX02A previously stalled at99%, has no retrievable result and was not duplicated. Its ten-credit submitted cost is included as a ceiling; observed account balance suggests that job was not charged or was refunded. The darkness source was cropped to remove generated letterboxing. Later oversized-looking foreground insects are excluded. Audio not listening-reviewed.

records.title: The Passover and the Death of the Firstborn
records.posterAlt: A household shares flat bread around a low table in a lamplit room.
records.description: A hand marks an ancient doorway beam. Inside, a household shares flatbread and food by lamplight, with the door closed and travel bundles ready.
records.reviewLimits: Selective Passover preparation and meal montage. Deaths, Egyptian mourning and Pharaoh's release order are omitted. Doorway cropped to hand and beam; no claim of a complete retelling. Sampled anatomy and identities reviewed; audio not listening-reviewed.

records.title: The Exodus from Egypt
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H.264 Main 3.1, one-second keyframes, no B frames, copied AAC, faststart MP4
records.posterAlt: Moses walks with households and animals away from Egypt toward cloud.
records.description: Moses leads households and animals away from Egypt toward a pillar of cloud. At night, the travelers move together across open wilderness toward a pillar of fire.
records.reviewLimits: Selective departure and guidance montage. The carried chest evokes Joseph's remains without identifying its contents. Legal instructions and the complete departing population are omitted. Rear night view avoids invented facial portraits. Audio not listening-reviewed.

records.title: Crossing the Sea
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H.264 Main 3.1, one-second keyframes, no B frames, copied AAC, faststart MP4
records.posterAlt: Travelers cross dry ground between towering walls of water.
records.description: Moses stands beside a path between walls of water. People and a loaded donkey cross on dry sand. Later, an elderly Miriam leads women with frame drums beside the sea.
records.reviewLimits: Selective sea-crossing and celebration montage. Uses only the final opened-path portion of EX05A and the stable dry-ground portion of EX05B; earlier generated transitions excluded. Omits pursuit, drowning and the full songs. Identities and sampled anatomy compared with approved Moses and elderly Miriam references; audio not listening-reviewed.

records.title: Bitter Water, Manna and Quail
records.posterAlt: A family gathers white manna into woven baskets at dawn.
records.description: Moses casts wood into bitter water. Quail settle beside a wilderness tent at evening. At dawn, a family gathers white manna into baskets.
records.reviewLimits: Selective Marah, quail and manna montage. Omits Elim, Sabbath instructions and disputes over stored manna. Manna is represented as white flakes. Audio not listening-reviewed.

records.title: Water from the Rock and the Battle with Amalek
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H.264 Main 3.1, one-second keyframes, no B frames, copied AAC, faststart MP4
records.posterAlt: Grey-haired Moses sits on a stone while Aaron in a striped mantle and another man support his outstretched arms from opposite sides.
records.description: Water flows from a rock as people fill jars. On a rocky hill, seated Moses holds his arms out while grey-haired Aaron and another man support his wrists and forearms from opposite sides.
records.reviewLimits: Selective water and supported-hands montage; battle stays offscreen. Corrected support shot preserves the approved grey-haired Aaron and distinct longer-bearded Moses in sampled frames at 6, 8 and 9.5 seconds. Arms are held outward at chest height. Sampled review, not every-frame certification; audio decoded but not listening-reviewed.

records.title: Jethro Advises Moses
records.posterAlt: Jethro gestures with open hands while Moses listens beneath woven shade.
records.description: Beneath a woven shade, Jethro gestures toward a waiting line while Moses listens. In the camp, elders hear visitors in smaller groups.
records.reviewLimits: Selective counsel and delegated hearings. The second shot is reframed to emphasize hearing groups and exclude an uncertain background portrait. Jethro's arrival, sacrifices and full instructions are omitted. Audio not listening-reviewed.

records.title: The Covenant and Ten Commandments at Sinai
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H.264 Main 3.1, one-second keyframes, no B frames, copied AAC, faststart MP4
records.posterAlt: An assembly waits below a dark cloud-covered mountain lit by lightning.
records.description: The assembly waits below the boundary at a cloud-covered Sinai as lightning flashes over the summit. Moses approaches the thick cloud while the people remain behind.
records.reviewLimits: Selective arrival and approach to cloud. The spoken covenant and commandments are not retold, and no tablets are shown. Final portion of the cloud shot is excluded. Audio not listening-reviewed.

records.title: The Covenant Is Sealed at Sinai
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H.264 Main 3.1, one-second keyframes, no B frames, copied AAC, faststart MP4
records.posterAlt: Moses and a companion walk up a rocky mountain path toward cloud.
records.description: Hands hold an open covenant scroll before the assembly and stone altar. Later, Moses walks uphill toward cloud while a companion follows and pauses below.
records.reviewLimits: Selective covenant reading detail and ascent. Moses's face is excluded from the scroll take because the full portrait drifted. Scroll has indistinct invented marks and makes no textual quotation. EX10A2 correction excluded for duplicate Moses-like figures in background. Sacrifice, blood ritual and elders' meal are omitted; ascent companion remains an unidentifiable rear view. Audio not listening-reviewed.

releaseStatus: All ten media objects verified and accepted for build 410. Publication and native installation remain gated on the final combined release checks.
